_dev_notes: DEV NOTE: Artefact routing manifest. This file classifies changed paths into coarse route groups so local and CI checks can choose the smallest lawful proof route.
DEV NOTE: groups[].patterns are path classifiers only. They must not define engine behaviour, release scope, legal authority, or CI token meaning.
DEV NOTE: decision routes are execution shortcuts for developer feedback. They must not be treated as proof of release readiness unless the routed command itself is the required gate.
DEV NOTE: ENGINE_RISK and APP_RISK classifications are intentionally conservative. Prefer over-checking risk surfaces rather than silently downgrading them.
DEV NOTE: Keep this file strict JSON. Do not add comments, trailing commas, JSONC syntax, or parser-specific extensions.
